description: Post a public reply to a comment on the originating network. Requires both `comment_id` and the `publication_id` from list_inbox_comments — Social0 verifies the comment is on that post before sending. This is a live public action.

media_id.description: Media upload ID. Only X and Bluesky accept comment attachments.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

name: reply_to_comment
title: Reply to comment
